observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor explains the choreography clearly by breaking it down into 8-count phrases. He demonstrates facing away from the camera to make following along easier.

lesson_structure.note: Instructor introduces himself and the dance: Backwood Bump.
Breaks down the first 8 counts of slide steps.
Breaks down the next 8 counts of rock crosses and paddle turns.
Breaks down the jazz box steps.
Breaks down the rocking chair and triple turns.

cues: All weight on that left foot
Make sure you don't jump that count
common_mistakes: Jumping the count and landing on the wrong foot

steps_taught.name: Rock crosses and paddle turns
steps_taught.description: Rock crosses followed by quarter turns.

steps_taught.name: Jazz box
steps_taught.description: Cross over, step back, step side.

steps_taught.name: Rocking chair and triple turns
steps_taught.description: Rock forward and back with turns.

what_works: Facing away from camera for easy mirroring
what_hinders: Advanced speed and terminology might be fast for beginners

quotes.text: Now this is a 48 count advanced line dance.
First thing we're going to do is do rock crosses.
We're going into quick steps that are lock steps.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor stands facing away from the camera, counting out 8 counts while stepping.

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down 48 counts into distinct 8-count phrases with back-facing demonstration throughout.
